title: Get Product SKPP Detail
content:
# Path: /product/202606/skpps/{product_id}
# Method: [GET]
# Function Description
Return the SKPP qualification status, current and target scores, task progress and suggested actions, reward eligibility and status, and offline snapshot time for one product. This API is available only to sellers authorized for SKPP in the US market.

---


# Common Parameters
For common parameters, refer to [How to call TikTok Shop APIs - Common Parameters](https://partner.tiktokshop.com/docv2/page/64f199679495ef0281851ee5#Back%20To%20Top)
| Properties <!-- width:110px --> | Location <!-- width:75px --> | Type <!-- width:75px --> | Require <!-- width:60px --> | Sample <!-- width:254px --> | Properties description <!-- width:254px --> |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| shop_cipher | query | string | Y | GCP_XF90igAAAABh00qsWgtvOiGFNqyubMt3 | Use this property to pass shop information in requesting the API. Failure in passing the correct value when requesting the API for cross-border shops will return incorrect response. |
| Get by API [Get Authorization Shop](https://partner.tiktokshop.com/docv2/page/6507ead7b99d5302be949ba9?external_id=6507ead7b99d5302be949ba9) |  |  |  |  |  |
| content-type | header | string | Y | application/json | Allowed type: application/json |
# Request Path Parameters
| Properties <!-- width:110px --> | Type <!-- width:90px --> | Require <!-- width:90px --> | Sample <!-- width:254px --> | Properties description <!-- width:254px --> |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| product_id | string | Y | 7311223344556677889 | Product ID generated by Tiktok Shop. |
# Request Query Parameters
| Properties <!-- width:110px --> | Type <!-- width:90px --> | Require <!-- width:90px --> | Sample <!-- width:254px --> | Properties description <!-- width:254px --> |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| app_key | string | Y | 38abcd | Every single app will have a unique key. Please use the specific key assigned to your app. |
| sign | string | Y | 5361235029d141222525e303d742f9e38aea052d10896d3197ab9d6233730b8c | Signature generated by gen algorithm. When you send API requests to TTS, you must sign them so that TTS can identify the senders. |
| timestamp | int | Y | 1623812664 | Unix timestamp GMT (UTC+00:00). This timestamp is used across all API requests. Developers can use this convert to local time. |
| locale | string | N | en | The BCP-47 locale codes for displaying category information. |
| Default: The default locale of your shop. |  |  |  |  |
| Possible values: |  |  |  |  |

* en
* en-GB
* zh-CN
* de-DE
* id-ID
* it-IT
* ja-JP
* ms-MY
* pt-BR
* th-TH
* vi-VN |

# Request Sample
**Query**
```Plain Text
https://open-api.tiktokglobalshop.com/product/202606/skpps/7311223344556677889?app_key=123abc&sign=5361235029d141222525e303d742f9e38aea052d10896d3197ab9d6233730b8c&timestamp=1625484268&shop_cipher=ROW_RHkDDABBAAB8tKAVoAqsMTjsQZFLyNfY&locale=en
```

# Response Parameters
| Properties <!-- width:110px --> | Type <!-- width:90px --> | Sample <!-- width:289px --> | Properties description <!-- width:289px --> |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| code | int | 0 | The success or failure status code returned in API response. |
| message | string | Success | The success or failure messages returned in API response. Reasons of failure will be described in the message. |
| request_id | string | 202203070749000101890810281E8C70B7 | Request log |
| data | object |  | Specific return information |
| ^product_id | string | 7311223344556677889 | Platform product ID. |
| ^affiliate_program_status | string | ACTIVE | Affiliate Program enrolment. Possible values: ACTIVE / INACTIVE. |
| ^total_score | int | 6 | Current SKPP total score, as of update_time. |
| ^target_score | int | 8 | Score threshold to qualify for SKPP. |
| ^rewards | []object |  | Reward list. |
| ^^reward_type | string | BIG_PROMOTION_CAMPAIGN | Possible values: ADS_CREDIT / TOP_CREATOR_MATCHMAKING / SHOPTAB_PV / BIG_PROMOTION_CAMPAIGN / OFF_PLATFORM_BESTSELLER_ADS_CREDIT. |
| ^^title | string | Ad credit reward | Localized reward name, resolved from the shared Seller-Center content by the request locale. |
| ^^status | string | AVAILABLE | Possible values: NOT_GRANTED / PENDING / AVAILABLE |
| ^^ad_credit_claim_status | string | UNCLAIMED | Ad-credit-only sub-status, returned only when reward_type = ADS_CREDIT and status = AVAILABLE. Possible values: UNCLAIMED (eligible, not yet claimed) / CLAIMED (claimed). |
| ^^value | string | 100 | Granted amount/quantity; currency-typed values lead with the currency symbol. |
| ^^claim_conditions | []object |  | Thresholds to unlock the reward; used by ADS_CREDIT. |
| ^^^condition_type | string | GMV | Possible values: GMV / ORDER. |
| ^^^current_value | string | 72 | Current progress; GMV-typed values lead with the currency symbol. |
| ^^^target_value | string | 100 | Threshold value; same formatting as current_value. |
| ^^campaign_id | string | 7390000000000000000 | Returned only for reward_type = BIG_PROMOTION_CAMPAIGN. |
| ^task_details | []object |  | Per-category score breakdown with suggested actions. |
| ^^category | string | INFORMATION_QUALITY | Key for the scoring category. |
| Possible values: |  |  |  |

* COMMISSION_RATE
* FULFILMENT
* PRICING
* FREE_SHIPING
* FOLLOWER_BENEFITS
* SAMPLING
* ADS_SPEND
* STOCK
* SHOPPABLE_VIDEOS
* INFORMATION_QUALITY
* CRM_HOSTING |
   ^^name |string |Improve product title |Localized category name, resolved from category via the shared content by the request locale. |
   ^^current_value |string |12 |Current value of this dimension's metric (e.g. current price, commission rate, free-shipping status). |
   ^^target_value |string |20 |The threshold this dimension must reach to pass. It uses the same unit as `current_value` and may include a leading comparison operator, such as `≥` or `≤`, to show the required direction. |
   ^^passed |bool |false |Whether this dimension meets its target_value. |
   ^^action_suggestions |[]object | |Suggested actions to complete this task; returned only when passed = false. A task may have multiple suggestions. |
   ^^^score_increase |int |8 |SKPP points added to total_score when this action is completed; for tiered actions, the maximum tier. |
   ^^^url |string |https://seller.tiktokglobalshop.com/product/edit |Link to the Seller Center page that completes the action. |
   ^update_time |int |1779148799 |Date of the offline data snapshot that total_score, rewards and the score breakdown are derived from, returned as a Unix timestamp in seconds, pinned to the last second of that date in UTC (23:59:59Z). The value is date-level only — the time component is always 23:59:59 UTC — because the SKPP scoring runs in an offline pipeline with no intraday granularity. Latency is typically T+1 (the evening of day N publishes the day N−1 snapshot) and at most T+2. |
   ^skpp_status |string |QUALIFIED |Possible values: QUALIFIED / NOT_QUALIFIED / NOT_ELIGIBLE. |

# Response Sample
```json
{"code":0,"data":{"product_id":"7311223344556677889","affiliate_program_status":"ACTIVE","total_score":6,"target_score":8,"rewards":[{"reward_type":"BIG_PROMOTION_CAMPAIGN","title":"Ad credit reward","status":"AVAILABLE","ad_credit_claim_status":"UNCLAIMED","value":"100","claim_conditions":[{"condition_type":"GMV","current_value":"72","target_value":"100"}],"campaign_id":"7390000000000000000"}],"task_details":[{"category":"INFORMATION_QUALITY","name":"Improve product title","current_value":"12","target_value":"20","passed":false,"action_suggestions":[{"score_increase":8,"url":"https://seller.tiktokglobalshop.com/product/edit"}]}],"update_time":1779148799,"skpp_status":"QUALIFIED"},"message":"Success","request_id":"202203070749000101890810281E8C70B7"}
```
